30 things you need to do alone
to truly know yourself

1. eat in a restaurant without your phone
2. spend an evening in silence
3. take yourself to a museum
4. walk somewhere new
5. read a whole book in one day

6. go to the cinema alone
7. do something that scares you
8. travel for a weekend
9. cook a real dinner for one
10. visit a library

11. write what you feel, show no one
12. cry without explaining why
13. watch the sunrise
14. learn a new skill
15. spend a day in nature

16. make peace with boredom
17. write a letter to your future self
18. sit in a café for an hour
19. try a new hobby
20. dance in your room

21. sleep without worrying
22. say no without guilt
23. go to a concert
24. take a long bath with a book
25. plan your dream life on paper

26. leave your phone at home for a day
27. learn one new thing every morning
28. walk without music
29. forgive yourself
30. sit with your thoughts
